newsitem.title: USA: Acer cuts PC prices in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Acer cuts PC prices in U.S..

text.p: Acer Inc's Acer America Corp on Monday said that it reduced prices up to 20 percent on its entire line of AcerPower desktop PCs.

In a statement, the company said the price cuts range from 9 percent to 20 percent. In addition, the company said it is offering resellers a $25 rebate and distributors a $25 credit for each system sold September through December 1996.

Acer said the AcerPower Business Multimedia minitower that ships with an Intel Pentium 166Mhz processor, 16MB RAM, eight-speed CD-ROM drive, 2.0GB hard disk drive, 256KB pipeline burst cache, and DMI software has an estimated street price of $2,160, down nearly nine percent from the previous level.

The AcerPower Pentium 133Mhz desktop with 16MB RAM,1.6GB IDE hard disk drive, 256KB pipeline burst cache, Microsoft Windows 95, and Acer's DMI software has been reduced by 17 percent and is now available for an estimated street price of $1,525.
